::: {.recap}
**Where we are.** Module 13 can evaluate a policy from logs. This module asks one question: *How do we improve a policy from a fixed log, without new data?*
:::

## What you will build {#build}

In this module you will:

- Show extrapolation error with naive offline DQN's Q-values on unseen actions.
- Implement behavior cloning and predict on which dataset it matches the best offline-RL method.
- Implement the discrete CQL penalty and IQL's expectile loss, and explain each from the failure it fixes.
- Compare methods by ground-truth rollouts and by FQE, stating seeds and budget.

## Before you start {#before}

- [Module 13 · Off-policy evaluation](/modules/13-off-policy-evaluation.qmd) and its lab: this module builds on what it left open.

- No API keys or paid services.
